output.headline: Nordic Capital can add the target to its open platform in the sub-sector, backed by four own-sub-sector deals and 18 adjacent provider deals.
output.differentiator: Most provider deals of any sponsor on the list (4 in the target's sub-sector, 18 adjacent), plus an open platform for add-ons. Welsh Carson and Advent also have open platforms.
output.why_them: Add-on to its open provider platform; deepest provider record among sponsors

acquirer_overview.title: Provider specialist sponsor: 22 of 24 deals in provider services
points: Financial sponsor with 24 deals from 2016 to 2024; 21 of 24 (88%) closed and 9 since 2022. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:recent]
Healthcare is one of four core industries; Fund XI closed at its EUR 9 billion hard cap (about $11 billion). [P:1, P:2]
Median deal $77M, largest $1,304M; 22 of 24 (92%) were control deals, not minority stakes. [T:record, K:control_share]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: An open platform in the sub-sector gives a ready add-on route
points: Four deals in the target's own sub-sector and 18 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; its sponsor angles are add-on to an open platform and provider specialist. [T:record, A:angles]
Platform Build in 7 of 24 deals shows a repeated platform-and-add-on motive that matches this target. [M:platform_build]
Midwest is the gap: 2 deals there, and the regional signal is against. A 2024 Midwest recapitalization shows it will transact there. [T:record, S:geo_fit, D:MA-2024-0431]

precedent_activity.title: Precedents run from $26M to $1,304M at 9.1x to 15.9x
points: Green Medical Center, 2022: $1,304M leveraged buyout at 15.0x EV/EBITDA, in the target's own sub-sector. [D:MA-2022-0045]
Harbor Medical Center, 2023: $991M leveraged buyout at 11.1x. Harbor Health Network, 2024: $35M carve-out at 11.6x. [D:MA-2023-0466, D:MA-2024-0339]
Principal Physician Group, 2024: $76M recapitalization in the Midwest at 15.9x. [D:MA-2024-0431]

valuation_context.title: 75th percentile is defensible, above Nordic's usual price
points: 70 comparable deals: 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median, 15.3x at the 75th. The target's 16.8% margin beats the 12.9% comps median and 87% of comps. [V:comps]
Nordic's median paid is 12.5x, but it paid 15.0x, 15.8x and 15.9x in Green Medical Center, Hudson Behavioral and Principal Physician Group. [V:comps, D:MA-2022-0045, D:MA-2023-0355, D:MA-2024-0431]
Ability to pay: 5.0x leverage, $128M equity cheque, 18.7% IRR at the ask versus a 20% target; maximum price $193M same exit, $216M at a 15.0x platform exit. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: Median deal of $77M is under half the target's $200M EV.
risk_flags.mitigant: It has done larger deals, including $991M and $1,304M buyouts, and 8 of 24 deals sit in the comparable size band.
risk_flags.reality: Capacity is proven; the open question is appetite for a mid-sized add-on. [T:record, K:size_band, D:MA-2023-0466]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask is 18.7%, below the 20% target.
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M, above the $200M EV.
risk_flags.reality: The ask works only on the add-on case; the same-exit ceiling of $193M falls short. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Thin Midwest footprint
risk_flags.concern: Only 2 of its 24 deals are in the Midwest, and the regional signal is against.
risk_flags.mitigant: One was a 2024 Midwest recapitalization at 15.9x, so it has recent local experience.
risk_flags.reality: Its deals cluster in the Mountain West, Great Plains and West Coast, so Midwest-focused sponsors on the list may compete harder. [K:by_region, S:geo_fit, D:MA-2024-0431]

conviction.rationale: Four own-sub-sector and 18 adjacent provider deals, an open-platform add-on route, and a #2 place on the priority list after review. The $77M median deal against a $200M EV is the main offset. [C:conviction, R:rank]
